title: OSTF Production Session 0.4.0
description: Complete Production 0.4, pinned to exact Score 5.1.0 bytes. Inherits Production 0.3 channels, devices, assets, automation and Audio Regions, and adds optional non-destructive Audio Take Groups.

audioRegions.description: Optional authored audio-region arrangement in source-score global Tick time. Does not modify OSTF Core Clips/Notes.

sidechainConnections.description: Optional typed, acyclic audio detector/key inputs to effect plugin ports; not part of normal audible output routing.

kind.description: audioTrack is a production-only recorded-audio channel, and MUST NOT claim a Core trackId. kind track still maps an OSTF Track exactly as in 0.1.

sampleRateHz.description: Audio-source decoded sample frames per second; required only for purpose audioSource.

frameCount.description: Number of decoded sample frames in the complete audio source asset; required for audioSource.

audioChannels.description: Mono/stereo decoded source-channel count; required only for audioSource in 0.2.

asset.description: Opaque asset descriptors. audioSource requires sampling metadata for frame-accurate regions; plug-in state remains uninterpreted and never executable merely by presence in JSON.

automation.description: Unique source-global-Tick automation lane. Boolean controls use step interpolation. A single lane per exact target; static value acts as baseline before first point where available. Device plugin parameters are normalized 0..1, while deviceControl.enabled/bypass are explicit booleans. Draft 0.8 adds exact numeric domain constraints (Channel/Send/Region dB, Pan, normalized Plugin Parameter), and boolean target type enforcement.

automationTarget.description: Channel, plugin parameter, Send, audio Region, or Device slot control automation target. Non-channel options added to the unpublished 0.2 development draft. References resolve within this Production Profile, not into MIDI CC or Core Note IDs.

audioRegion.description: Source-score-tick audio segment on a production track or score-bound track channel, referencing a bounded range of exact audioSource PCM-decoded frames.

playbackMode.description: native maps ideal source-time seconds to sample frames at sampleRateHz; fit uniformly maps authored global Tick progress to the selected frame interval.

pitchPolicy.description: Required for fit; preserve means retain source pitch as a musical goal, followRate means speed/rate-based pitch change. Both are DSP/host dependent.

sidechainConnection.description: Directed detector/key signal from sourceChannelId to named key input port of an effect Device belonging to a different audio channel. Does not mix into its audible output path.

targetPortId.description: Opaque plugin-format-scoped sidechain input identifier. A host must verify the port actually exists; no port auto-matching by label.

followMute.description: If true, source channel mute suppresses this sidechain; if false, the detector feed can remain present even when that source channel is muted audibly.

takeOrigin51.description: Optional inert provenance. Actor/session/proposal identifiers and prompts do not confer permissions or perform any network or generation action.

takeVisitSelection51.description: Comp selection overlay for one existing finite Performance Plan Visit. The Plan/Visit pair must be unique per Group. null denotes silence. Only the Group/Visit source-range intersection is selected.

takeSelectionHistory51.description: Informational saved-selection history, strictly increasing in sequence within its Group. Historical deleted Comp IDs may be retained; history never changes current selection or playback.

takeTransition51.description: Declared crossfade window strictly containing an adjacent different-source junction at atTick. Windows must be disjoint, inside the Group, and backed by both source handles. regions output supports linear only; equalPower/customRendered are already baked into rendered output and must not be reapplied.

takeLiveSelection51.description: Optional launch-time selection policy. fixed/manual have no candidates; cycle/random/weighted require distinct Comp IDs. weighted requires all nonnegative weights and at least one positive weight. Distinct compId values and reference resolution are semantic constraints.

audioComp51.description: A complete ordered partition of the Group's range into selected source or explicit-silence regions. The map is the editing authority; ordinary materialized output is playback authority. All-silence Comp has no outputs; any source region requires at least one output descriptor (MIDI may contain an empty notes array). IDs and ranges must resolve consistently in a single authoring transaction.

activeCompId.description: One Comp ID in this Group, or null for silence. Empty comps requires null. This saved selection controls the ordinary output flags; Visit/live selection overlays do not rewrite these saved flags.

audioTakeGroup51.description: Non-overlapping source-score Tick range owned by channelId. All ranges use Score PPQ, are half-open, and have safe-integer endpoints. Sources and independently identified materialized outputs remain on the existing timeline; source candidates never play as ordinary active clips. References, ownership, range sums, unique scoped IDs and flags require semantic validation in addition to this schema.

$comment: Integrated OSTF 5.1 written specification, 2026-11-25. Inherited schemas are preserved separately. Local reference integrity and publication structure are distinct from semantic conformance and implementation/runtime certification. Timing coordinates and their arithmetic endpoints must remain safe integers.
